title: Allow mana_plan to specify which ability to use on multi-ability lands
description:
When a mana_plan entry references a multi-ability permanent (e.g. dual lands, filter lands), the system currently auto-selects the sole ability or cancels the spell if there are multiple (BridgeCallbackHandler.java GAME_CHOOSE_ABILITY handler, line ~3518).

This means models must "avoid multi-ability permanents" in their mana plans, which is a significant limitation.

Possible approach: extend the mana_plan string format to support ability selection, e.g. "p1:1" to select ability index 1 on object p1. Plain "p1" would keep current behavior (auto-select sole ability, cancel on multi). The colon-index syntax would let the GAME_CHOOSE_ABILITY handler pick the right ability instead of cancelling.

This would let models use dual lands, filter lands, and other multi-ability permanents in mana plans.
